# Show Desk

> Show Desk is show secretary software for German-style breed shows — Sieger shows, SE
> (Standard Evaluation) events, and breed surveys. It records the judge's spoken critique
> ringside, transcribes it live, and delivers the official critique certificate to the
> owner's inbox the same day.

## What Show Desk does

- Ringside critique recording with live speech-to-text, keyed to armband numbers
- SE (Standard Evaluation) digital forms: measurements, bite, behavior, gun-sureness, final result
- Formwert ratings (V, SG, G, and the other official codes) with placements 1–4 kept in
  separate pools per class, sex, and show day
- Official PDFs: critique certificates, SE forms, award certificates, judge-report drafts
- Same-day email delivery of approved critique certificates to owners
- Offline-first ringside capture that queues on the device and syncs when coverage returns

## Key terms

- A Sieger show is a German-style conformation show where every dog is critiqued aloud by
  the judge and receives a written critique, a rating, and a placement of 1–4 in its class.
- A Richterbericht is the judge's written critique of a dog. Under ADRK rules, judge reports
  rated V or SG are required documents for a Körung (breed survey).
- In a rating like V1, the letter is the rating (V, vorzüglich, Excellent) and the number is
  the placement within the class. They are separate: many dogs can earn V, but only four place.
- An SE (Standard Evaluation) is a structured single-dog evaluation covering measurements,
  bite, temperament, and gun-sureness, ending in a pass or fail with a Formwert rating.

## Public results archive

- /results — index of published Sieger shows
- /results/{show-slug} — all official ratings, placements, and critiques for one show
- /results/{show-slug}/{armband-dog-slug} — one dog's result page (shareable, indexable)

A show is public only after the club publishes it. Public pages never include owner
emails, addresses, audio recordings, or unpublished drafts.
